reviews.text: Mr Duston and his crew are awesome. They did great work on my home after a hail storm caused damage in my town. I would highly recommend them for your contracting needs.

reviews.text: We are very pleased with our new black roof and gutters. Michael was our sales rep and did a great job! He was thorough and detail-oriented and made the right design suggestions. Highly recommend this roofing company.
reviews.author: Aimee Halloran

reviews.text:
Had showtime replace my roof last week after a hailstorm in April this year. These guys are amazing Not only did they get me an amazing price on the roof they also worked closely with my insurance to make sure I got every benefit I was entitled to.

Was upgraded to a 30 year shingle and got to select the Color. The roof looks stunning. Not only does it look good but the work was done right. I had a few sections of rotted deck and they replaced it with the right radiant batter wood. We have had a long stretch of heavy rain since the roof was replaced and not a drip made its way into our house.

They also completed the entire job in one day and didn’t leave a single nail behind. The crew was vigilant getting all the trash up knowing I had a small child that likes to play in the yard.

We couldn’t be happier with our roof!

Thanks Showtime!!
reviews.author: Eli Lucero
